name: code-block
blurb: Syntax-highlighted code display with copy button and optional file tabs.
description: Code block using Prism syntax highlighter with filename display and copy-to-clipboard functionality. Supports multi-file tabs with per-tab language and highlighting.
use_when: Displaying code snippets in documentation, tutorials, or blog posts with syntax coloring.
avoid_when: When line-by-line editing is needed or when inline code is sufficient.
a11y: Copy button has visual feedback. Tab navigation through keyboard. Code text is selectable.
